referee_caveats_inferred: Only one observed object defines the conditions, so the probabilities are anecdotal
The 2.8% estimate rests on assumed 70%, twice, 10 Myr quiescence statistics
The blue plus red composite is illustrative and not fitted to data, with no uncertainties
The E(B-V)=0.6 mag and f=0.44 are chosen as a worst case
No ALMA data are analysed, so the ALMA prediction is untested
